title.value: An Empirical Study of Retrieval-enhanced Graph Neural Networks
title.justification: The paper's title directly states its focus on enhancing Graph Neural Networks using retrieval techniques.
title.quote: An Empirical Study of Retrieval-enhanced Graph Neural Networks

extractions.description: This paper explores how Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can be enhanced through retrieval-augmented methods, which have shown success in other domains like language and vision. The authors design a retrieval-enhanced scheme called GRAPH RETRIEVAL, which augments GNNs by retrieving annotated examples from databases to aid in graph property predictive tasks. Their study demonstrates that such enhancements improve the performance of GNNs across various datasets and tasks, particularly in handling long-tailed label distributions.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on methodological advancements in Graph Neural Networks, with no specific mention or emphasis on climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: In this study, we focus on two common tasks in the realm of graph neural networks: graph classification and graph regression.
